user.title: Connect Feedrion
user.description: Home Assistant will show a code to type in the Feedrion app. Feedrion Premium is required.

data_description.api_url: Leave the default unless told otherwise. https only.

code.title: Type this code in the Feedrion app
code.description:
In the Feedrion app, open Settings ▸ Integrations ▸ Connected devices and type **{code}** — or open {url}. The app shows what is asking before you approve.

Once approved in the app, come back here and submit.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Feedrion
reauth_confirm.description: The Feedrion session of this Home Assistant ended (it was disconnected from the app). Pair it again with a new code.

progress.wait_for_code: Waiting for the Feedrion app to approve **{code}**. In the app: Settings ▸ Integrations ▸ Connected devices, or {url}.

error.https_required: The address must start with https://

abort.expired: The code expired before it was confirmed. Try again.
abort.pairing_failed: Feedrion refused the pairing. Details are in the Home Assistant logs (search for “feedrion”).

data.feeds: Feeds with their own sensor (and new-article events)

data_description.feeds: 50 at most. Only these feeds fire feedrion_new_article.
data_description.stock_provider: Feedrion never relays share prices: Home Assistant quotes My stocks itself, with your own free key, straight from the provider.
data_description.stock_api_key: Kept in Home Assistant and sent to that provider only.
data_description.stock_interval_minutes: Never below the free plan's floor (Twelve Data 15, EODHD 60, Alpha Vantage 180). Home Assistant spends at most half your daily allowance; the phone spends the rest.

error.key_required: A key is needed for this provider.
